name: design-prototype
description: Build working clickable product prototypes for co-design. Two-tab pattern: product.html (real interactions — hover, click, type, drag) + design.html (ClaudeDesign panel for proposals and roadmap). Conversation happens in the Claude terminal; the prototype reloads as you talk. Use when the user wants to dogfood a product and shape it through chat, not pick between A/B/C cards or get a static mockup.
